data.description: The imported DomainSpec authoring workflow did not require each generated artifact to be reviewed by a distinct agent; independent review had to be added explicitly for docs/features/agents-communication-infra.
data.suggestedFix: Require author/reviewer identity separation per artifact and a frozen digest for multi-file closure reviews.

data.rootCause: Cross-aspect input ordering, receipt identity and orphan publication-candidate semantics were inconsistent after initial composition.
data.resolution: Three independent reviewers drove remediations and a final frozen-baseline PASS/PASS/PASS closure.

data.description: Treat publication.persisted as a durable candidate only; official acceptance requires verified receipt, while orphan candidates may be abandoned only by audited CAS after terminal unknown without recoverable evidence.
alternatives: Make unknown candidates permanent and forbid retry
data.rationale: Separates append-before-ack durability from quorum authority and preserves safe retry without deleting evidence.

data.changeDescription: Add mandatory per-file author/reviewer separation, immutable review manifests and a final three-axis closure protocol for multi-file specs.
data.rationale: This session required explicit orchestration to obtain independent authorship/review and caught semantic defects only after frozen cross-file review.

data.description: Ratified ETD-1 through ETD-7: Python/FastAPI host, Pydantic core validation with runtime-owned canonical bytes/digests, and a local subprocess provider behind SandboxLauncher.
alternatives: Octopus Runtime or Eve as kernel runtime
data.rationale: The alternatives overlap existing authority or assume the wrong runtime host; boundary-local use remains possible only behind explicit evidence gates.

data.summary: External-tool admission should be evaluated per authoritative fact and named seam, not by feature-name overlap.
data.context: The ACI journal, audit ledger, artifact boundary and provider adapters have disjoint authority; similarly named external runtime capabilities may still duplicate truth.
data.applicability: Features evaluating workflow runtimes, schema libraries, evidence helpers or provider frameworks beside established authoritative stores.

data.description: Accepted ADR-001 for the SWU-ACI-001 decision scope with SQLite/WAL/FULL, one writer, atomic receipt-event-head-intent acceptance, pure replay and runtime-owned canonical bytes.
alternatives: Treat Pydantic serialization as canonical authority
Require TASK-010 runtime proof before accepting its prerequisite ADR
data.rationale: Independent authority, SQL and vector reviews proved the contract fixtures while keeping downstream executable conformance separate from W0 decision acceptance.

data.rootCause: Initial fixtures under-enforced digest alphabets and UPDATE/DELETE immutability, omitted required tables/tests, and coupled ADR acceptance to downstream TASK-010 proof.
data.resolution: Three independent review axes drove two bounded remediations and final PASS/PASS/PASS on a frozen baseline.

data.summary: A prerequisite ADR must be acceptably reviewable without requiring executable evidence from the runtime task that the ADR gates.
data.context: SWU-ACI-001 initially required TASK-010 crash and dependency-lock proof for ADR acceptance, creating a gate cycle.
data.applicability: Work packs that separate contract-freeze waves from later executable conformance waves.

data.missingDetail: Final document recheck found a non-canonical Concept Graph relationship and a mismatch between the three configured caps and the four independently tested cap classes.

data.rootCause: Initial aspect had broken authority links, generic query envelopes, missing rule-test traceability and orphan registry concepts.
data.resolution: One remediation fixed those issues; the mandatory final recheck exposed two residual contract mismatches and stopped further mutation.

data.description: Kept canonical vault reads inside agents-communication-infra as an effect-free W0 projection with host-owned admission and one ephemeral snapshot per call.
alternatives: Create a second vault registry authority
Persist snapshots and paginate across requests in L0
Add vault routes to the live ledger control-plane server
data.rationale: The selected boundary preserves source authority, avoids mixing ACI runtime with the current control plane and remains honest under the blocked runtime/work-pack gate.

data.description: Resolved ATD-6 by treating legacy-managed as a pre-confirmation route outside ACI runtime confirmation; only runtime-managed creates one ConfirmedDispatch and one Run. Closed helper_probe provenance, canonical graph-edge and four-cap test residues.
alternatives: Create ConfirmedDispatch for both authority modes
Introduce a synthetic Mapping only to retain a non-canonical graph edge
Collapse per-file and aggregate byte limits
data.rationale: The selected contract follows the existing ConfirmRuntimeDispatch operation, preserves the legacy session authority, keeps DomainSpec graph typing valid and makes each vault-read bound independently falsifiable.
